items.body: صفقة ضخمة اكتملت الخطوة الأخيرة لأسطورتي البرازيل رونالدو وروبرتو كارلوس ليصبحا مساهمين في نادي إنتر دي ليميرا، وهو نادٍ متواضع سيشارك في دوري الدرجة الثانية البرازيلي (سيري ب) الموسم المقبل. في 31 أغسطس/آب، وافقت الجمعية العمومية للنادي البرازيلي، بأغلبية 53 صوتاً مقابل صوت واحد، على استحواذ شركة -يرتبط بها اللاعبان السابقان- على حصة قدرها 80% من الهيكل المؤسسي الجديد للنادي، المعروف في البرازيل باسم "الشركة المساهمة لكرة القدم" (SAF). وقد جرى التوقيع رسمياً على الاتفاقية اليوم الاثنين، أما نسبة الـ 20% المتبقية، فستظل بحوزة النادي نفسه بحسب ما ذكرت صحيفة " آس " الإسبانية. إنريكو أمبروجيني هو رائد الأعمال الذي يقود هذا المشروع، والذي يضم -وفقاً لشبكة "جلوبو إسبورتي" البرازيلية، كلاً من رونالدو، وروبرتو كارلوس، والأمير السعودي عبد الله بن سعد بن عبد العزيز آل سعود. وفي شهر يوليو/تموز الماضي، كشف روبرتو كارلوس أن أحد الشركاء الآخرين من أصول أفريقية. في تصريحات نقلتها شبكة "جلوبو إسبورتي" في شهر سبتمبر، أكد أمبروجيني أن هذا "مشروع ضخم"، وأنه "يختلف تماماً عن أي تجربة أخرى شهدتها البرازيل فيما يتعلق بـ SAF (تحويل نادي كرة القدم إلى شركة)". ووفقاً للمصدر ذاته، تعتزم المجموعة التجارية التي ستتولى إدارة النادي استثمار ما يصل إلى 76 مليون يورو على مدى عشر سنوات؛ علماً بأن هذا المبلغ قد ي…

items.title: You can make this DIY controller in six hours and for less than 12 bucks—but would you want to?
items.summary: I think I'll stick with my GameSir Nova Lite.
items.body: In my past life as a console gamer, I was wary of any controller not bundled in with my first-party hardware. These days though, there are lots of excellent PC gamepad options—particularly in the budget category—but how cheap is too cheap? Our current pick for the best PC controller that won't hurt your wallet is the GameSir Nova Lite . This costs comfortably under $30 on a good day, but how low can you go in the budget realm? Well, how about a pad you can make yourself in about six hours for €10 (or about $11.22)? The catch is… uh, well, just look at it . Dubbed the Undercooked V0.4, this thing doesn't have a D-pad or even a full set of face buttons. Instead, this project limits itself to a single analogue stick, 'X' and 'A' inputs, a menu button, and a 'B' button that's been relegated to the pad's right shoulder. According to the creator, Lazy_Duck, "the idea was to make it simple, affordable and that you could get all components even in the smallest electronics shop quick and cheap." items.summary: The best deal in controllers at $30 or less right now.
items.body: The GameSir Nova Lite 2 is our new best budget controller for PC. It's extremely well equipped considering the small asking price. Depart with just $30 / £30 of your hard-earned cash, and you'll receive a wireless controller with Hall effect sticks, mechanical D-pad, trigger stops, and programmable rear buttons. There's enough here that even GameSir's own exceedingly popular G7 Pro is at risk of cannibalisation. The Nova Lite 2 doesn't look that out of shape by comparison, with only quality of life and more advanced features between them. Such as a handful of micro switches and a bigger battery. The G7 Pro is a better all-round controller, but for less than half the cash, the Nova Lite 2 is tough to ignore. There are some drawbacks with a controller at this price. The plastic doesn't feel great and it's not overly grippy. The software could be smarter and the shoulder buttons wider, too. But they all seem savvy sacrifices for the savings that the Nova Lite 2 delivers. items.summary: It could be smoother but double the frames is nothing to sniff at.
items.body: As a console gaming interloper, I've been watching the PlayStation 5 emulation scene from afar with some interest. The latest development to catch my eye is that emulation of the Demon's Souls Remake, which has been exclusive to Sony's console since its 2020 launch, can now run at up to 120 fps on PC. Leveraging the very much unofficial KytyPS5 translation layer, YouTuber Geralt Benchmarks shared footage of the remake running on their RTX 5070 and AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D rig. The game reaches for more than 100 fps at 1440p resolution thanks to 2x DLSS frame generation, and you can watch it achieve a mostly buttery 120 fps at 1080p at the eight minute mark here . Otherwise on Sony's hardware, the game is locked to 60 fps and 1440p resolution while in performance mode. Doubling the frames via emulation is impressive to say the least, especially for what is still a current-gen console. For the sake of comparison, Geralt Benchmarks also shows the game running on their RTX 5070 rig with those PS5 settings left in place, turning in a performance that occasionally crests over the 70 fps mark. items.summary: "Everything was on the line" during Outlast's development.
items.body: Outlast has long since established itself as a horror gaming staple with an impressive track record of two mainline games, a DLC, and an online multiplayer game that still scares the bejesus out of me. So it's hard to believe that there was a time when developer Red Barrels was unsure whether or not it'd even be able to get it out of the door. After trying and failing to convince Ubisoft to let him make a horror game and just generally feeling like it was time to move on, Philippe Morin, co-founder of Red Barrels decided to leave and form a small 10-person team with developers from other big-budget studios. Their first pitch: a horror game. (Image credit: Red Barrels) “We thought at first that we’d come up with the pitch within three or four months and shop it around to a few publishers," Morin says in an interview with GameSpot . But in the case of The Outlast Trials, making something sickeningly good took a lot of struggle. As Red Barrels co-founder Philippe Morin told Gamespot in a recent interview , it took six years to turn the vague notion of a co-op Outlast game into something ready to launch via early access. It was "a fucking long time," as he recalled it, and the product of "a shit-ton of prototypes." "[The Red Barrels team] went too far trying to make [The Outlast Trials] systemic, random, and trying to reach our ultimate goal of infinite replayability," he told Gamespot. If it becomes law, the bill will see the US Federal Trade Commission create regulations that protect our "ability to own and play" purchased games, according to Torres' office. items.body: I had such high hopes for the Street Fighter movie: The trailers were so promising, the cast so charismatic, and it seemed to get the inherent ridiculousness of the franchise, playing it seriously without ever really taking it too seriously. I mean, you don't put a guy like David Dastmalchian in the role of M. Bison unless you expect him to do something with it, right? Alas, it seems that this may be a real Tuesday , at least for my Street Fighter movie aspirations. The reviews are in, and they are not especially kind. Street Fighter isn't a complete catastrophe, according to the critical consensus, but I don't think JCVD has to worry about having to turn in his "Best Street Fighter Movie" trophy anytime soon, either. Here's what they're saying: "Dumber than a box of rocks, but have you ever thrown rocks at things? items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever devs say gear upgrades will stay relevant 'for a long, long time': 'It's very much our intention to try wherever we can to not invalidate old content'
items.summary: Blizzard says items won't work like the modern version of the MMO.
items.body: The developers of World of Warcraft: Forever, the venerable MMO's newest 'Classic+' flavor, say that even though the level cap is staying at 60, there will always be new gear to chase, and lower level gear has never been more powerful. Blizzard Entertainment developers are wary of the drastic increases in power in WoW's modern version, including the recent Midnight expansion, which render previous seasons of gear irrelevant, require massive resets between expansions and lead to periodic stat "squishes" to avoid players becoming omnipotent gods. "Classic wasn't far off from this," vice president and senior game director Ion Hazzikostas said of Forever's approach in a recent PC Gamer interview. "It's gradual. Going from [Classic raids] Blackwing Lair to Ahn'Qiraj that's actually only a couple of item levels higher. Those two largely coexist. C'thun drops are probably better than anything in Blackwing Lair, but that's like one or two items per player. This is a system that can last for a long, long time."
